learning_objective: 🎯 Let's learn about the beauty of dancing together in groups, sharing our unique styles, and celebrating teamwork!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: In a group dance, lots of people move together at the exact same time. This takes a lot of practice and teamwork, but it creates stunning patterns on the stage!
Every person has their own special way of dancing and moving to the rhythm. When we share our dance moves with friends, we learn new things from each other.
Art and dance teach us to appreciate everyone! It is wonderful to clap and cheer for the amazing and different talents of all our classmates.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Draw a Circle of Dancers!
fun_activity.instructions: Draw a large circle of friends holding hands and dancing together. Color each friend in a different bright color to show how beautiful we are when we unite!

quick_recap: ⭐ Group dancing requires teamwork so everyone moves together perfectly.
⭐ We can learn fun new dance moves by watching and sharing with our friends.
⭐ Celebrating our differences makes art, dance, and life much more exciting.
